slide1.headline: Indian AI Startup Emergent Becomes Unicorn
slide1.subtitle: With $1.5 Billion Valuation

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Event date: 15 Jul 2026
Indian AI startup Emergent raised $130 million at a $1.5 billion valuation.
This makes Emergent the third AI unicorn of 2026.
The funding round was led by Creaegis.
Emergent's valuation has reached $1.5 billion.

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: This funding will help Emergent expand its AI coding platform.
The company plans to use the funds to improve its technology and hire more talent.
Emergent's success is a testament to the growing demand for AI solutions.
The company's valuation is a significant milestone in the Indian startup ecosystem.

slide4.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: Emergent's success could lead to more Indian startups focusing on AI.
The company's valuation could lead to a surge in investments in the Indian startup ecosystem.
Emergent's AI coding platform has the potential to disrupt the traditional coding industry.
